selection_method: Availability sample of completed valid v4 responses at the compute cutoff. Production traversed SHA-256-derived job keys in sorted order, with the five prototype jobs also included. Not a stratified or designed probability sample.
limitations: Only 122 of 819 deduplicated postings are LLM-cleaned; 697 remain outside the LLM dataset.
The sample covers 29 of 30 search-query categories with unequal, small counts; comparisons within job categories are unstable.
Availability, prototype selection, successful completion, search-query selection, and duplicate grouping can affect representativeness.
Coverage and extractor agreement are descriptive, not accuracy, labor-market population estimates, or causal evidence.
Part 2 comparison must use the same 122 job keys; full Part 2 counts must not be compared directly with sample counts.
